name: Creamy Pasta
description: Delicious creamy pasta with garlic and herbs.
steps:
1. Boil pasta
2. Sauté garlic
3. Add cream and herbs
4. Mix with pasta
5. Serve hot

name: Veggie Salad
description: A healthy mix of fresh vegetables and lemon dressing.
steps:
1. Wash and chop veggies
2. Toss in a bowl
3. Add lemon dressing
4. Serve chilled

name: Masala Omelette
description: Spicy Indian-style omelette packed with flavors.
steps:
1. Beat eggs
2. Add chopped veggies and spices
3. Pour on hot pan
4. Cook both sides
5. Serve with toast

name: Chocolate Mug Cake
description: Quick and easy chocolate cake in a mug, ready in minutes!
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients in a mug
2. Add milk and oil
3. Stir well
4. Microwave for 1-2 minutes
5. Let cool and enjoy
